development_failures_this_pass.reason: Screen initialization in the creative smoke world redirected to GuiContainerCreative, replacing the click container. The Refill fixture now explicitly selects survival and restores the original game type, capabilities and container afterward.
Expected look/use arrived in FIFO order, then an unrelated keepalive made the exact packet count fail. Original-channel routing and a forced regression were added; no production FIFO fix was made.
Diagnostic confirmed full hotbar, empty cursor and healthy player; earlier GUI-close NPE identified an uninitialized test screen.
Repeated diagnostic run used the same uninitialized test inventory; normal screen setup was then added and diagnostic-only direct event injection removed.

Refill test constructed GuiInventory without normal screen initialization; onGuiClosed threw and quarantined its activation. Fixed the fixture using setWorldAndResolution, without changing production close behavior.
